title: Dead Energy II - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Dead Energy II in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dead Energy II is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Gain AP when an ally falls.

sections.title: How to Get Dead Energy II
Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
